name: Jake English
source:
Jake is first introduced in Act 6 of Homestuck and befriended in Volume 12 of Pesterquest.

An adventurous young man with an old-fashioned way of speaking, Jake lives alone on an island filled with hostile monsters. He's close friends with Jane, Roxy, and Dirk.

[spoiler]Though he refers to Jade as his grandmother, Jake is actually an alternate universe version of Jade's grandfather - who, unbeknownst to Jade is actually her biological father.[/spoiler]
